description: Source code for table-related actions in the Notesnook editor, including moving rows/columns, importing/exporting CSV, and selecting table cells.

methods.name: moveColumnRight
methods.description: Moves the selected table column to the right if possible.

methods.name: moveColumnLeft
methods.description: Moves the selected table column to the left if possible.

methods.name: moveRowDown
methods.description: Moves the selected table row down if possible.

methods.name: moveRowUp
methods.description: Moves the selected table row up if possible.

methods.name: selectRow
methods.description: Selects the next or previous row in the table.

methods.name: selectColumn
methods.description: Selects the next or previous column in the table.

methods.name: importCsvToTable
methods.description: Imports CSV data into the table, creating rows and cells accordingly.

methods.name: exportToCSV
methods.description: Exports the selected table as a CSV file, with permission check.
